name: Restaurant Food Props
summary: Ten stylised restaurant dishes and drinks on a floor-centred 1.0 x 0.6 metre serving tray.
description: Original low-poly noodle bowl with chopsticks, rice plate, soup bowl, three pleated dumplings in a basket, two triangular sandwich halves on a plate, two cups with bent straws, salad bowl, pastry plate and sauce ramekin. One shared opaque vertex-colour material; ten independently movable service meshes plus tray. No text, logos, packaging or external assets.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry; seed 73129; one shared vertex-colour material. No external models, images, textures, fonts or brands.

display.origin: Tray underside centre at floor datum

accuracy_notes: Static stylised visual props; no eating, cooking, pickup logic, colliders or animations are included. Named dish nodes allow later runtime placement. Food layers intentionally intersect within each dish. Full restaurant mini-game integration, complete mall draw-call budget/frame rate, physical Android/iOS and WebKit remain unverified. Browser and source evidence are recorded separately.
